limits: Pools and their source configurations remain on the same device/browser; they are not synchronized to the server.

Catalog certification samples three seeds, all offered levels and sixteen source positions; it does not exhaust every possible range or seed. Actual pool configurations are checked before saving and new draws before replacement.
Guided activities keep human assessment; duels and rooms use only answer-verifiable questions.
Physical phone/ENI tests and cold-start offline are not covered.
